newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil direct investment at $5.9 bln-paper.
newsitem.headline: Brazil direct investment at $5.9 bln-paper.

text.p: Foreign direct investment in Brazil amounted to $5.9 billion in the first five months of this year, up 82.1 percent from the same period last year, a financial newspaper said.
The figure represents 64 percent of total foreign direct investment in 1996 and exceeds by far the total sum of the years 1993 to 1995, Gazeta Mercantil said.

If the average monthly inflow of foreign direct investment this year remains at the current level of $1.19 billion then total investment this year will reach $14.3 billion, up from $9.2 billion in 1996, Gazeta said.
((--Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
